stem.text: Two parallel metal plates are at electric potentials of $+800\,\text{V}$ and $+1300\,\text{V}$.
Which diagram best represents the electric field between the metal plates?

A.alt: Two vertical parallel plates labelled +800 V (left) and +1300 V (right), with field lines drawn between them, curved near the plate edges, arrowheads pointing left.

B.alt: Two vertical parallel plates labelled +800 V (left) and +1300 V (right), with field lines drawn between them, arcs above and below the plates, arrowheads pointing left.

C.alt: Two vertical parallel plates labelled +800 V (left) and +1300 V (right), with field lines drawn between them, curved near the plate edges, arrowheads pointing right.

D.alt: Two vertical parallel plates labelled +800 V (left) and +1300 V (right), with field lines drawn between them, arcs above and below the plates, arrowheads pointing right.
